review.decision: Verify path identity and behavior through independent readback before offering repair.
review.notes: Temporary homes only. Production migration and physical device behavior are outside unit evidence.

cases.expected: Use the canonical private cache path, preserve inode on cache hit and return no thumbnail for an unknown agent.
